about: Ground truth by reading for round 4 (fresh independent attacks) run on iteration 3, written by Claude AFTER the results were seen, independently of what the tool said.

Z01-bound-test-same-values-other-checks.note: The bound test moved 13 from a refusal check to an acceptance check: same values, same calls, so rule 15's sets saw nothing.

Z02-limit-read-from-module.note: The bound test reads its limit from money's own exported constant; the test's text did not change.

Z03-blank-line-after-each-message.note: No rule covers how messages are separated on a channel.

Z04-stream-chosen-into-variable.note: The stream is chosen into a variable, so no stream name appears where the message is written.

Z05-amount-built-by-static-factory.note: money's change is wrong (Amount built as a class instance by a static factory); bookings, meter, billing and front fail, untold, and money's check does not see it.

Z06-wrapping-handler-error-kind.note: The handler wraps the call, so it did not inherit the changed error kind.

Z07-handle-method-handed-on.note: A method of a handed-out object, handed to map, gained an optional parameter; 'handed on as a value' covered functions only.

Z08-second-overload-hands-back.note: Only the first of two overloads was listed.

Z09-list-parameter-becomes-rest.note: A list parameter became a rest parameter; read as 'accepts more'.

Z10-readonly-list-now-sorted.note: A read-only list parameter became writable (and is sorted in place); the comparison ignored read-only.

Z11-request-lines-change-nothing.note: A type parameter's constraint narrowed; the comparison ignored constraints.

Z12-returned-text-kind-bound.note: The bound sits on Slug, a text kind slugify hands back; bounds of a number or text kind were carried for fields and parameters, not for what is handed back.

Z13-static-method-hands-back.note: Static members of a class are not listed.

Z14-member-may-be-undefined.note: A member written '| undefined' rather than '[get]' was not seen as possibly missing.

Z15-uncommented-module-changed.note: A real change to a module without interface comments, without the comments-only first step; nothing enforces rule 6.

Z16-random-booking-ids.note: crypto is a Node global the tool's description of Node leaves out.

Z17-filter-boolean.note: filter(Boolean) removes the missing values; the reader does not know it.

Z18-object-groupby.note: Object.groupBy runs on Node 22; the reader's library is 2023.

Z19-at-sign-in-bound-line.note: An @ inside a bound line's words cut the line short in the reader's comment parser.

Z20-test-helper-renamed.note: Three notices for nothing: the bound tests' fingerprints kept the name of a renamed helper.

Z21-throws-explained-in-two-lines.note: One notice for nothing: the same error kind stated twice was counted as a change.
